import json, subprocess, sys, time, random

def run(req):
    line = json.dumps(req)+'\n'
    t0=time.time()
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=line,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=200)
    return time.time()-t0, r.returncode, r.stdout.strip()[:60], r.stderr[:200]

def mkflow(rng, fid, nodes, pathlen, H, nd, tmpl=None):
    path = rng.sample(nodes, pathlen)
    kinds = ['K']*H
    idx=list(range(H)); rng.shuffle(idx)
    kinds[idx.pop()]='Q'; kinds[idx.pop()]='T'
    for k in rng.sample(idx, nd): kinds[k]='D'
    return dict(id=fid, path=path, template=tmpl or ''.join('%02x'%rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(H)),
                kinds=''.join(kinds))

def gen(seed, nf, nn, pathlen, cap, H=16, nd=4, count=3, jitter=True):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    nodes = ['n%d'%i for i in range(nn)]
    caps = {n: cap for n in nodes}
    flows = [mkflow(rng, 'f%02d'%i, nodes, pathlen, H, nd) for i in range(nf)]
    offers = {}
    for f in flows:
        b = bytearray(bytes.fromhex(f['template']))
        b[f['kinds'].index('Q')] = 3
        b[f['kinds'].index('T')] = 250
        offers[f['id']] = [dict(header=bytes(b).hex(), count=count + (i if jitter else 0)) for i in range(1)]
    return dict(mode='plan', capacities=caps, flows=flows, warmup=0, pinned=[], offers=offers)
